# v3.20-dev

## Changed

- **Restoring your view is now a rule the build enforces, not a convention.**
  The last two releases fixed three pages that forgot your filters when you
  opened someone's record and pressed Back — Compliance Planning, the program
  dashboard and the offering dashboard. Each was the same mistake, and each was
  only found because someone hit it.

  The build now checks every page that holds a view — filters, search, sort,
  geography scope, pagination, a projection horizon — and refuses a new one that
  cannot restore it. A new report inherits the rule automatically rather than
  depending on whoever writes it remembering.

## Known gaps this surfaced

Turning the check on found five existing pages with the same problem. They are
recorded rather than quietly waved through, and none of them is new:

- **Dashboard** — geography scope and the "include expired" toggle are lost on
  reload.
- **Theatre/Region/Country Comparison** — the largest one: geography mode, date
  range, three filters, compare mode and sort are all lost.
- **Catalogue Health** — product, type and status filters are lost.
- **Program Compliance Trend** — theatre/region/country scope is lost.
- **Renewal Forecast** — product filter and geography scope are lost.

Nothing about these pages has changed in this release; they behave exactly as
they did before. They are listed so the list can be worked through, and the
check refuses to let it grow.

## Notes for self-hosted installs

No database changes and no configuration changes. This release adds a build-time
check only — nothing in it alters how the application runs.
